title: Data Quality
description: Missingness, cleaning rules, and early leakage awareness.

levels.name: Foundation
levels.description: Can count missing values by column, write a rule instead of a silent fillna, and name when a field becomes known — under written guidance.

levels.name: Apprentice
levels.description: Can tell a process story for missingness — not only a count — refuse a silent fill, and flag a field that would leak future information into a present-tense table.

levels.name: Practitioner
levels.description: Can independently write a cleaning checklist specific enough for a new file, apply rules in versioned code, and record a leakage example with the moment the field is known.

levels.name: Journeyman
levels.description: Can diagnose a 'clean' table that dropped rows or filled without a rule, cite the missingness pattern that was a process signal, and produce a checklist another analyst can apply without asking you.

levels.name: Mastery Evidence
levels.description: Can review another apprentice's cleaning notes, name a silent fill or a leakage field they treated as a feature, and teach how to read missingness as process on an unfamiliar file.
